title: Psalm 63
opening_line: Lord, thee my God, I’ll early seek:

source.note: Received text from the official Free Church digital edition and plain-text archive.

text.diplomatic: Lord, thee my God, I’ll early seek:
text.normalized: Lord, thee my God, I’ll early seek:
text.reading: Lord, thee my God, I’ll early seek:

text.diplomatic: my soul doth thirst for thee;
text.normalized: My soul doth thirst for thee;
text.reading: my soul doth thirst for thee;

text.diplomatic: My flesh longs in a dry parched land,
text.normalized: My flesh longs in a dry parched land,
text.reading: My flesh longs in a dry parched land,

text.diplomatic: wherein no waters be:
text.normalized: Wherein no waters be:
text.reading: wherein no waters be:

text.diplomatic: That I thy powèr may behold,
text.normalized: That I thy powèr may behold,
text.reading: That I thy powèr may behold,

text.diplomatic: and brightness of thy face,
text.normalized: And brightness of thy face,
text.reading: and brightness of thy face,

text.diplomatic: As I have seen thee heretofore
text.normalized: As I have seen thee heretofore
text.reading: As I have seen thee heretofore

text.diplomatic: within thy holy place.
text.normalized: Within thy holy place.
text.reading: within thy holy place.

text.diplomatic: Since better is thy love than life,
text.normalized: Since better is thy love than life,
text.reading: Since better is thy love than life,

text.diplomatic: my lips thee praise shall give.
text.normalized: My lips thee praise shall give.
text.reading: my lips thee praise shall give.

text.diplomatic: I in thy name will lift my hands,
text.normalized: I in thy name will lift my hands,
text.reading: I in thy name will lift my hands,

text.diplomatic: and bless thee while I live.
text.normalized: And bless thee while I live.
text.reading: and bless thee while I live.

text.diplomatic: Ev’n as with marrow and with fat
text.normalized: Ev’n as with marrow and with fat
text.reading: Ev’n as with marrow and with fat

text.diplomatic: my soul shall fillèd be;
text.normalized: My soul shall fillèd be;
text.reading: my soul shall fillèd be;

text.diplomatic: Then shall my mouth with joyful lips
text.normalized: Then shall my mouth with joyful lips
text.reading: Then shall my mouth with joyful lips

text.diplomatic: sing praises unto thee:
text.normalized: Sing praises unto thee:
text.reading: sing praises unto thee:

text.diplomatic: When I do thee upon my bed
text.normalized: When I do thee upon my bed
text.reading: When I do thee upon my bed

text.diplomatic: remember with delight,
text.normalized: Remember with delight,
text.reading: remember with delight,

text.diplomatic: And when on thee I meditate
text.normalized: And when on thee I meditate
text.reading: And when on thee I meditate

text.diplomatic: in watches of the night.
text.normalized: In watches of the night.
text.reading: in watches of the night.

text.diplomatic: In shadow of thy wings I’ll joy,
text.normalized: In shadow of thy wings I’ll joy,
text.reading: In shadow of thy wings I’ll joy,

text.diplomatic: for thou mine help hast been.
text.normalized: For thou mine help hast been.
text.reading: for thou mine help hast been.

text.diplomatic: My soul thee follows hard; and me
text.normalized: My soul thee follows hard; and me
text.reading: My soul thee follows hard; and me

text.diplomatic: thy right hand doth sustain.
text.normalized: Thy right hand doth sustain.
text.reading: thy right hand doth sustain.

text.diplomatic: Who seek my soul to spill shall sink
text.normalized: Who seek my soul to spill shall sink
text.reading: Who seek my soul to spill shall sink

text.diplomatic: down to earth’s lowest room.
text.normalized: Down to earth’s lowest room.
text.reading: down to earth’s lowest room.

text.diplomatic: They by the sword shall be cut off,
text.normalized: They by the sword shall be cut off,
text.reading: They by the sword shall be cut off,

text.diplomatic: and foxes’ prey become.
text.normalized: And foxes’ prey become.
text.reading: and foxes’ prey become.

text.diplomatic: Yet shall the king in God rejoice,
text.normalized: Yet shall the king in God rejoice,
text.reading: Yet shall the king in God rejoice,

text.diplomatic: and each one glory shall
text.normalized: And each one glory shall
text.reading: and each one glory shall

text.diplomatic: That swear by him; but stopped shall be
text.normalized: That swear by him; but stopped shall be
text.reading: That swear by him; but stopped shall be

text.diplomatic: the mouth of liars all.
text.normalized: The mouth of liars all.
text.reading: the mouth of liars all.
